Sample.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/14] The random regression analysis showed that rates of improvement over time in the 2 treatment groups were significantly different (treatmenttime interaction, F1,114=9.80; P=.002).

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] At week 12, adolescents who received IPT-A compared with those who received TAU reported significantly greater improvement in dating (F2,60=4.7; P=.03) and overall social functioning (F2,60=7.0; P=.01) and a trend for greater improvement in family functioning (F2,60=2.8; P=.10) on the SAS-SR.
